title: Office Cleaning Cost for 5 to 20 Employees: Small-Suite Rates, Minimums & Budgets
seoTitle: Office Cleaning Cost for 5 to 20 Employees: 2026 US Benchmarks
metaDescription: Office cleaning cost for 5 to 20 employees: $390–$7,264/mo across 750–4,000 sq ft suites, $90–$135 trip minimums, and frequency tips. Open our calculator.
excerpt: See realistic 2026 US monthly and per-visit office cleaning budgets for small teams of 5 to 20 employees occupying 750 to 4,000 sq ft suites. Learn how the $90–$135 visit minimum and the 2,500 sq ft rate step-down shape vendor proposals.
quickAnswer: Office cleaning cost for 5 to 20 employees typically runs $486 to $831 per month for a 750 sq ft suite cleaned weekly ($112 to $192 per visit), $1,377 to $2,338 per month for a 1,200 sq ft suite cleaned twice weekly, and $4,280 to $7,264 per month for a 3,500 sq ft suite cleaned 3 times per week. Because small teams span the under-2,500 sq ft bracket ($0.12 to $0.20/sq ft) and the 2,500–9,999 sq ft bracket ($0.09 to $0.15/sq ft), crossing 2,500 sq ft often lowers your unit rate noticeably.

blocks.text: Small commercial tenants with **5 to 20 employees** routinely get blindsided by janitorial quotes. On paper, a 1,000 sq ft office looks simple to maintain—yet vendors price it very differently per square foot than a 10,000 sq ft floor because fixed mobilization overhead and **$90 to $135 per-visit minimums** dominate small-suite economics.

Using US workspace averages of **150 to 250 usable sq ft per employee**, a 5-to-20-person team typically occupies **750 to 4,000 sq ft** with one or two restrooms. Understanding exactly where your suite sits inside the national [Office Cleaning Cost Guides](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/) brackets helps you budget accurately without sacrificing insurance compliance.
2026 Office Cleaning Budgets for 5 to 20 Employees by Suite Size

In standard US commercial proposals, suites under 2,500 sq ft carry base rates of **$0.12 to $0.20 per sq ft per visit**, while suites from 2,500 to 9,999 sq ft drop to **$0.09 to $0.15 per sq ft**—both plus **$15 to $30 per restroom per visit** and scaled by frequency (**1.08x** weekly, **1.00x** 2x/week, **0.95x** 3x/week across **4.333 weeks per month**).

blocks.caption: 2026 US Office Cleaning Cost Benchmarks for 5–20 Employee Suites (Commercial Carpet, 1.00x National Average)

blocks.text: Notice the pricing cliff right at 2,500 sq ft. Because the base square-footage bracket steps down from **$0.12–$0.20/sq ft** to **$0.09–$0.15/sq ft**, a **2,400 sq ft suite** with two restrooms cleaned 2x/week averages **$318 to $540 per visit** (**$2,754 to $4,676/month**), whereas a slightly larger **3,000 sq ft suite** on the exact same 2x/week schedule averages **$300 to $510 per visit** (**$2,598 to $4,417/month**).

blocks.title: Why 500 to 750 Sq Ft Suites Hit the $90–$135 Visit Minimum
blocks.text: For an ultra-compact 500 sq ft office with one restroom cleaned weekly, raw square-footage math yields only ~$80 on the low end—so reputable insured vendors enforce a $90 to $135 minimum trip fee ($390 to $598 per month at 4.33 visits/month) to cover drive time, W-2 crew mobilization, and insurance overhead.
How Frequency, Floor Surface, and Add-Ons Shift Small-Office Totals

Many 5-to-20-employee teams work in hybrid arrangements or share small suites with dense hard-surface breakrooms and glass huddle rooms. Both **floor finish** and **common-area add-ons** move small budgets meaningfully because fixed per-visit add-ons represent a larger percentage of a $200–$400 visit.

blocks.caption: Scope & Flooring Adjustments on a 3,500 Sq Ft Office (18–20 Employees, 2 Restrooms, 3x/Week)

blocks.text: If your office features **engineered hardwood** (**1.08x** multiplier) or **ceramic tile and grout** (**1.12x**) instead of carpet tiles (**1.00x**), expect base floor charges to rise **8% to 12%**. Conversely, startups in lofts with **polished concrete** (**0.95x**) save roughly **5%** on base floor labor because dust mopping and damp auto-scrubbing clear open floors fast.

In a 15-to-20-person office, two restrooms and one compact kitchenette generate 70% of daily employee complaints when neglected. Confirm your contract explicitly includes **sink basin descaling, microwave interior/exterior wiping, refrigerator door handles, and high-touch cabinet pulls** rather than leaving kitchenettes out of the base scope.

If your building landlord provides common-corridor restrooms outside your suite, remove the **$15 to $30 per restroom** line item from your bid audit—that single deduction saves **$130 to $780 per month** depending on your weekly cleaning frequency.
Equipment Specs That Keep Small Suites Clean Without Dusting Desks

Tight workstation aisles and shared conference tables in small suites make heavy upright vacuums clumsy and loud. Experienced commercial crews serving 750 to 4,000 sq ft suites rely on **sealed HEPA backpack vacuums** to capture fine dust rather than venting allergens back onto monitors. Proven commercial units include the **ProTeam Super Coach Pro 10** (10 qt capacity, 4-Level HEPA filtration, 12.5 lb chassis, 66 dBA sound level) and the **Sanitaire SC412A Commercial Backpack** (10 qt capacity, Sealed HEPA filtration, 11.5 lb weight, 68 dBA) for corded speed, or the **Hoover Commercial MPWR 40V Cordless** (6 qt capacity, HEPA media filtration, 14 lb weight, Cordless 40V battery) when suites lack conveniently placed outlets.

blocks.title: Do Not Let Small-Suite Size Excuse Missing COI or W-2 Coverage
blocks.text: Solo cleaners targeting 1,000 sq ft offices frequently skip Workers' Compensation or quote under $25 implied hourly rates. Require a Certificate of Insurance ($1M/$2M General Liability Additional Insured + Workers' Comp + fidelity bond) and OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200) SDS sheets before handing over suite keys.
5 Budget Tips for 5 to 20 Employee Offices
Compare small-suite proposals fairly in our [Quote Comparator](/compare-cleaning-quotes/) and apply these five cost controls:

items.name: Target Mid-Week 1x or 2x/Week Windows
items.text: Ask vendors for Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday slots—see our [day-of-week pricing guide](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/office-cleaning-cost-by-day-of-week/)—to trim $10–$25 off small-suite trip minimums.

items.name: Buy Paper Towels, Tissue, and Liners Directly
items.text: Stocking your own bulk dispensers avoids vendor consumables markups ($0.012–$0.025/sq ft/visit), saving $150–$400+ per month on 2,000–3,500 sq ft suites.

items.name: Clarify Landlord Restroom Boundaries
items.text: Verify whether restrooms inside your lease corridor belong to building janitorial staff so you do not pay twice for the $15–$30/restroom fee.

items.name: Choose an Independent W-2 Vendor for Under-2,500 Sq Ft Suites
items.text: Review [independent vs. franchise cost differences](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/cost-difference-independent-cleaner-vs-franchise/)—local W-2 teams often beat franchise visit minimums while keeping quality high.

items.name: Plan Ahead as Headcount Approaches 25 Staff
items.text: When expanding past 4,000 sq ft, review [25 to 50 employee office cleaning budgets](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/office-cleaning-for-25-to-50-employees/) to re-bid at lower mid-tier per-square-foot rates.

faqs.q: What is a realistic monthly cleaning budget for a 10-person office?
faqs.a: A typical 10-employee office occupies roughly 1,500 to 2,000 sq ft with one or two restrooms. Cleaned twice weekly (8.66 visits/month), a 1,500 sq ft suite with one restroom averages $1,689 to $2,858 per month ($195 to $330/visit), while a 2,000 sq ft suite with two restrooms averages $2,338 to $3,984 per month ($270 to $460/visit).

faqs.q: Why do cleaners charge a $90 to $135 minimum per visit for tiny offices?
faqs.a: Even a 500 sq ft suite takes at least 45 to 75 minutes when factoring in parking, security alarm entry, equipment setup, restroom sanitizing, and trash haul-out. Combined with W-2 payroll taxes, Workers' Compensation, and $1M/$2M liability insurance, contractors lose money dispatching a crew for less than $90 to $135 per stop.

faqs.q: How do 4.333 weeks per month affect a small-office weekly cleaning invoice?
faqs.a: There are 52 weeks in a year divided across 12 months, equaling 4.333 weeks per month (4.33 in most calculators). A 1x/week contract averages 4.33 visits per month and a 2x/week contract averages 8.66 visits per month, preventing surprise fifth-week invoices four times a year.

faqs.q: Are carpet cleaning and inside-fridge cleanouts included for 5–20 person offices?
faqs.a: No. Standard recurring quotes cover trash emptying, surface dusting, vacuuming, damp mopping, and restroom/breakroom surfaces. Hot-water carpet extraction, VCT floor waxing ($0.03–$0.06/sq ft/month amortized), interior window glass ($15–$35/visit), and refrigerator cleanouts are priced as add-ons or $55–$95/hr specialty tasks.

faqs.q: Should a small office request Green Seal GS-37 chemicals and OSHA documentation?
faqs.a: Yes. Even in a 1,000 sq ft suite, US OSHA Hazard Communication (29 CFR 1910.1200) requires labeled bottles and accessible Safety Data Sheets (SDS) on site, and restroom bodily fluid incidents fall under OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030). Requesting Green Seal GS-37 or EPA Safer Choice solutions typically adds only 0% to 4% to material costs.
